events.summary: Christian McKee (vocals, mandolin) and Paul Prato (bass) began playing together in 2004, and have played together ever since. When The Big North Duo plays the audience smiles, toes tap, and everyone gets a break from the workaday world. The music comes from the deep catalogs of classic swing, blues and country, and also features original material drawing from those traditions. On any given night the music may be swinging hard or it may be mournful, but it’s always from the heart.
events.title: The Big North Duo

events.summary: Ian Joe Bailey is a musical group out of Portland, OR playing acoustic songs that step into a variety of different genres and styles. The group can consist of a solo show with just Ian, or sometimes accompanied by a snazzy and radiant horn section (trumpet or sax) that fills the songs out with much for the listener to hold on to. Influenced by many different artists with many different styles, the group plays older folkish, rock, funkish, reggae-type, latin inspired material, boleros, and many songs that came from marvelous appreciation of South American bands like Chico Trujillo, Natiruts, Jorge Ben Jor, Novos Baianos, Nonpalidece and so many more.

events.summary: Known for writing 'fun lil bummer' bops and slinging harmonies around Portland, OR, Aika Collins crafts heavy heart-break and dreamy folk-pop songs that are thoughtful and show resilience. Katie Waterland is a Portland-based singer-songwriter blending introspective lyricism with warm, organic instrumentation. She released the EP, The Tape Session, in 2019, showcasing her ethereal voice and heartfelt songwriting. Katie performs live around Portland venues and collaborates with fellow local artists, crafting immersive sets that connect deeply with her audience.
